biography: Mark 'Griff' Griffith burst onto the Australian racing scene from the unlikeliest of places: competitive online sim racing. His uncanny ability to predict and react to virtual track conditions translated surprisingly well to real asphalt. Griffith's father, a mechanic with a passion for speed, recognized his son's raw talent and scraped together enough savings to get him into a local karting series. One defining moment came during a downpour at the state championships – while others spun out, Griffith calmly threaded the needle, gaining five positions in a single lap. That race caught the eye of a Porsche Cayman GT4 CS MR team owner. Now, at 22, Griffith is considered a rising star, known for his aggressive overtakes and willingness to push the car to its absolute limit. He's currently focused on climbing the ranks in the GT4 series, aiming for a spot in a higher-tier championship within the next few seasons.
drivingStyle: Griffith's driving style is characterized by a high-risk, high-reward approach. He's known for late braking and aggressive corner entries, often pushing the limits of grip. While this can lead to spectacular overtakes, it also makes him prone to occasional errors. His tire management, while improving, is still an area where he needs to refine his technique. He thrives under pressure, often delivering his best performances when the stakes are highest, and seems to relish wheel-to-wheel battles.

rivalries.name: Isabelle Rossi
rivalries.reason: A fierce competitor in the same GT4 series, Rossi is known for her consistent pace and tactical driving. Griffith and Rossi have clashed on numerous occasions, with Griffith often attempting daring overtakes that Rossi deftly defends against.

rivalries.name: Kenji Tanaka
rivalries.reason: Tanaka, a veteran racer, represents the old guard that Griffith is trying to displace. Their rivalry is based on contrasting styles - Tanaka's smooth, calculated approach versus Griffith's raw aggression.

rivalries.name: Ricardo Silva
rivalries.reason: Silva and Griffith were teammates briefly. Their rivalry began when Silva felt Griffith received preferential treatment from the team, leading to on-track incidents and heated exchanges off the track.

quirks: Always wears the same pair of lucky socks gifted to him by his grandmother.
Listens to heavy metal music at full volume right before getting into the car.
Has a habit of talking to his car, often giving it pep talks before each race.
famousQuote: "You gotta risk it to get the biscuit!"
careerHighlight: Winning the GT4 State Championship in his rookie season after starting from the back of the grid due to a qualifying penalty.
careerLowPoint: Crashing out of the lead in the final lap of a major endurance race due to overdriving, costing his team a potential victory.
